title: Powerball's Rules Made An Already Unlikely Jackpot Harder To Win
hook: Powerball's jackpot odds worsened to about 1 in 292 million after rule changes.
closing: A bigger-looking jackpot does not make a ticket likelier to win; check the odds before spending.
question: Do changing odds change whether you play?

segments.say: Lifetime lightning odds are about one in 15,300 in this comparison. That lifetime risk is not a lottery ticket's single-draw chance.
The listed lifetime shark-attack odds are one in 11.5 million. Rare events still need matching exposure periods for a fair comparison.
The later jackpot odds became one in 292,201,338 per play. The rule change made an already unlikely win harder.
